visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long auburn hair, a pink jeweled butterfly hair clip, and a grey sweatshirt sits in a warmly lit indoor room, holding a small cyan-blue spray bottle towards her palm. (2) She sprays the bottle, accompanied by white explosive graphic lines and a large variety-show text overlay, while maintaining a cheerful facial expression and looking directly at the camera. (3) The scene cuts to a screen-within-a-screen showing her previous viral video where she is standing in a grey skirt, putting a product into her pocket in a bedroom setting. (4) A product layout appears on a clean grey background showcasing the 'LACTOMEDI' Intimate Care Gel for Women and its packaging. (5) Back to the main character, she continues talking, now with cartoon pineapple and germ icons appearing around her head to illustrate her points. (6) A series of informational graphic cards are shown, explaining the product ingredients, scent profile (watermelon, jasmine), and pH balance with charts and text. (7) The woman reappears, holding both the spray bottle and the gel applicator, demonstrating how to use them together while smiling and gesturing. (8) Golden confetti graphics and promotional discount text overlays appear over the woman as she points upwards, indicating a limited-time offer. (9) She displays multiple product combinations, including a cleaning foam and soothing cream, against the same indoor background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy female voice speaking rapidly in Mandarin, accompanied by an upbeat electronic pop BGM with a strong 4/4 drum beat. (2) A quick 'whoosh' transition SFX plays as she emphasizes a keyword, and the vocal pitch remains consistently high and friendly. (3) A 'pop' bubble SFX triggers when Variety-show text appears on screen, while the BGM maintains its steady tempo. (4) As informational graphics are shown, the narrator's tone shifts slightly toward a more structured, informative delivery while keeping the high arousal level. (5) Another 'ding' SFX marks the introduction of the discount details, where the vocal intensity increases to build excitement. (6) The video concludes with a friendly sign-off as the BGM fades out sharply with a final energetic phrase from the narrator.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Personal Experience -> Product Explanation -> Technical Evidence -> Promotional Discount -> Closing CTA
